sourceBasis: Original 2026-11-05 ClinicalTrials.gov archived deep snapshot plus NCT-linked original issuer releases and publications
sourcePolicy: Supplement historical original documents; do not alter original ClinicalTrials.gov snapshot or falsely call journal-described endpoints registered. A withdrawn/unstarted trial stays without an observed efficacy result. Do not impute FDA decisions or RAAS scores.

records.study: ISIS 3521 (Affinitak)/LY900003 plus carboplatin/paclitaxel, advanced non-small cell lung cancer
records.primaryEndpoint: Overall survival; primary log-rank comparison of Affinitak plus chemotherapy against chemotherapy alone
records.outcomeEvidence: Company reported primary log-rank p=0.81, median overall survival 10.0 versus 9.7 months. Later stratified analyses do not reverse the primary trial result.
records.caveat: This source is a 2003 issuer result, not a late-added registered outcome. Do not conflate second 2004 ALERT trial using gemcitabine/cisplatin.

records.study: C-100-12, vitespen HSPPC-96 renal carcinoma adjuvant trial
records.outcomeEvidence: ITT recurrence-free survival HR 0.923 (95% CI 0.729–1.169), p=0.506; already adjudicated in original ledger.
records.caveat: Only cohort Part I RFS outcome; do not infer a Part II success.

records.study: C-100-21, vitespen HSPPC-96 stage IV melanoma trial
records.outcomeEvidence: Primary intention-to-treat overall survival was not improved versus physician's choice; source reports HR 1.16 and p=0.32.
records.caveat: Do not promote selected high-dose exposure survival subgroup to primary success.

records.study: ISIS 2302-CS20 alicaforsen North America Crohn's disease
records.primaryEndpoint: Clinical remission by week 12, Crohn's Disease Activity Index (CDAI) ≤150
records.outcomeEvidence: Issuer disclosed two matching Phase III studies failed to significantly induce clinical remission versus placebo; peer-reviewed 2007 paper confirms neither individual study nor pooled analysis met primary endpoint.
records.caveat: Exact NCT maps to protocol ISIS 2302-CS20. Combined 33.9% versus 34.5% remission is pooled across both Phase III studies and must not be assigned as trial-specific arm rates.

records.outcomeEvidence: Issuer disclosed both parallel Phase III studies did not significantly improve week-12 clinical remission; peer-reviewed report confirms neither individual nor pooled primary comparison met.
records.caveat: Exact NCT maps to protocol ISIS 2302-CS21; do not infer trial-specific percentage from published pooled efficacy table.

records.study: BCX1812-312, intramuscular peramivir for uncomplicated influenza
records.outcomeEvidence: Original ClinicalTrials.gov states withdrawn for administrative reasons after revised dose-ranging plan; actual enrollment zero, so no completed observed primary efficacy endpoint exists.
records.caveat: Planned efficacy/safety study is identifiable but exact prespecified primary outcome measure is not recorded. Do not borrow time-to-alleviation from other peramivir trials, and do not call it an efficacy failure.
